description: This file contains ARM assembly implementations of SHA-256 hash function routines, including platform-specific optimizations for ARMv4, ARMv7, ARMv8, and NEON instructions. It includes the main block processing function and platform-specific variants, with embedded licensing and comments.

methods.name: _sha256_block_data_order
methods.description: Assembly implementation of SHA-256 block processing for ARM architectures, optimized for ARMv4 and later.

methods.name: _sha256_block_data_order_neon
methods.description: NEON-accelerated implementation of SHA-256 block processing for ARM architectures supporting NEON.

methods.name: sha256_block_data_order_armv8
methods.description: ARMv8 optimized implementation of SHA-256 block processing.
